question:
A customer who intends to purchase an appliance has three coupons, only one of which may be used:

Coupon \(1:\) \(10\%\) off the listed price if the listed price is at least \(\$50\)

Coupon \(2:\) \(\$20\) off the listed price if the listed price is at least \(\$100\)

Coupon \(3:\) \(18\%\) off the amount by which the listed price exceeds \(\$100\)

For which of the following listed prices will coupon \(1\) offer a greater price reduction than either coupon \(2\) or coupon \(3?\)
solution:
All five listed prices exceed \(\$100\), so all three coupons apply. Let \(p\) be the listed price in dollars. The reductions offered by coupons 1, 2, and 3 are respectively
\[
0.10p,\qquad 20,\qquad 0.18(p-100).
\]
The last expression uses only the amount above \(\$100\), as coupon 3 requires.

Coupon 1 gives a greater reduction than coupon 2 precisely when
\[
0.10p>20,
\]
which means \(p>200\). To beat coupon 3 as well, it must satisfy
\[
\begin{aligned}
0.10p&>0.18(p-100),\\
18&>0.08p,\\
p&<225.
\end{aligned}
\]
Thus the listed price must lie strictly between \(\$200\) and \(\$225\). The endpoints would give ties with a competing coupon, so they are excluded. Only \(\boxed{\$219.95}\) lies in this interval, giving choice C.
